title: The Book That Knew My Name

lines.text: In 1897, a library in Vienna received a book with no author.
lines.caps: In *1897, | a library in *Vienna | received a book | with no *author.

lines.text: The title page was blank. The pages were blank. Until someone read them.
lines.caps: The title page was *blank. | The pages were *blank. | Until someone *read them.

lines.text: The first reader saw a love story. She read it twice, and returned it weeping.
lines.caps: The first reader saw | a *love story. | She read it *twice, | and returned it *weeping.

lines.text: The second reader saw a sea voyage. He'd never left Austria. He left anyway.
lines.caps: The second reader saw | a *sea voyage. | He'd never left *Austria. | He left *anyway.

lines.text: By 1910, the library kept it in a locked room.
lines.caps: By *1910, | the library kept it | in a *locked room.

lines.text: Because every reader saw a different book. About themselves.
lines.caps: Because every reader saw | a *different book. | About *themselves.

lines.text: In 1938, the book vanished. The lock was untouched. The dust, unbroken.
lines.caps: In *1938, | the book *vanished. | The lock was *untouched. | The dust, *unbroken.

lines.text: For eighty years, readers wrote letters to it. None were answered.
lines.caps: For eighty *years, | readers wrote *letters to it. | None were *answered.

lines.text: Last year, a girl checked out an old blank book by mistake.
lines.caps: Last *year, | a girl checked out | an old *blank book | by *mistake.

lines.text: She returned it with a note: 'Thank you. I didn't know my ending yet.'
